# Collection hangs in the worktree probe: -timeout must abort the run, emit
# no summary and preserve the silent/debug behavior.

exec /usr/bin/git init -q
exec /usr/bin/git checkout -q -b main
exec /usr/bin/git config user.email tester@example.com
exec /usr/bin/git config user.name Tester
exec /usr/bin/git add f
exec /usr/bin/git commit -q -m one

cd $GITMUX_DIR
go build -o $WORK/gitmux .
cd $WORK

chmod 0755 bin/git
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

# Debug mode: the timeout aborts collection, nothing is written to stdout and
# the error is reported on stderr.
! exec ./gitmux -dbg -timeout 200ms
cp stdout fail.out
cp stderr fail.err
! exec /usr/bin/grep -q . fail.out
exec /usr/bin/grep -q . fail.err

# Silent mode: aborted as well with no output at all.
! exec ./gitmux -timeout 200ms
cp stdout silent.out
cp stderr silent.err
! exec /usr/bin/grep -q . silent.out
! exec /usr/bin/grep -q . silent.err

-- bin/git --
#!/bin/sh
# Block indefinitely on the identity/generation probe; everything else is
# delegated to real git.
case "$1 $2" in
"rev-parse --absolute-git-dir")
	exec /bin/sleep 30
	;;
esac
exec /usr/bin/git "$@"

-- f --
one
